summary: Tested Achievement/Medals System. All 16 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed for both Admin (7/10 achievements) and Bronce user (1/10 achievements). Progress bars, category grouping, locked/unlocked visual states all working correctly.
passed_tests: ✅ GET /api/user/achievements - Returns all 10 achievements with unlocked status, progress percentage, newly_unlocked list
✅ Admin user has 7/10 achievements unlocked (first_login, kyc_verified, first_investment, first_withdrawal, level_plata, level_oro, level_platino)
✅ Achievement auto-detection works: each achievement checks real DB data (transactions, login_history, user level)
✅ /achievements page loads with progress bar showing X/10 and percentage
✅ Unlocked achievements show icon, name, description, date with golden border
✅ Locked achievements show lock icon and gray/dimmed styling (opacity-60)
✅ Achievements grouped by category: Basicos, Transacciones, Inversion, Actividad, Niveles
✅ Sidebar shows 'Logros' link with Trophy icon
✅ Progress bar animates correctly (70% for admin, 10% for bronce)
✅ All 10 achievements defined: first_login, kyc_verified, first_investment, first_withdrawal, streak_5, active_user, committed_investor, level_plata, level_oro, level_platino
✅ Category distribution: basico(2), transacciones(1), inversion(2), actividad(2), niveles(3)
✅ newly_unlocked field returns list of newly unlocked achievements
✅ Locked achievements have no unlocked_at date
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing admin and test.bronce users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Achievement system fully tested. 10 achievements across 5 categories: basico (first_login, kyc_verified), transacciones (first_withdrawal), inversion (first_investment, committed_investor), actividad (streak_5, active_user), niveles (level_plata, level_oro, level_platino).
